title: Graphics Manifest Index 2.0
description: A graphics-manifests.json index selects registered graphics-definition documents for automatic loading.
$comment: Indexes live under a directory named graphics. References resolve from that enclosing graphics/ directory and must identify exact registered files. Repeated references are loaded once. Runtime loading does not open this schema or unreferenced JSON files.

$schema.description: Optional editor-resolvable schema reference; the runtime does not load this file.

items.description: Forward-slash JSON path relative to the enclosing graphics/ directory. The target must be a registered graphics-definition document, not another index. Parent traversal is not allowed.
